verses.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles who were carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:

xrefs.text: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Like these good figs, so I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chaldeans.
I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger; the staff in their hands is My wrath.
